snippet.title: Palettopia | Cozy City-Building Puzzle Game - Official Teaser
snippet.description:
Take a sneak peek at the world of Palettopia! In this Creative Mode teaser trailer, we showcase our beautiful pop-up book stylization, vibrant new art, and four distinct biomes.

📅 Join our upcoming Creative Mode Playtest from July 16th – July 23rd!
🎨 Wishlist Palettopia on Steam: https://tinyurl.com/ym9ah83b
